paragraphs.text: Sursi is a large plateau in the southern part of the Aerona continent of Dominaria and also the name of a village in this area.

The plateau is covered by plains and home to a race of fabled mesa pegasi . When a woman marries in Sursi, she must visit the mesa. It is said that if the woman is pure of heart, she and her family will be blessed by a pegasus. The Plains of Sursi lie east of the Erg Mirab . Sursi is divided from Venaria by a large inlet.

Here, in the cold waters of a deep lake, was contained the only portal from Dominaria to Ulgrotha , which was likely deactivated by the effects of the Mending . Using the portal required one to pass a doorway made of three "menhir stones" when the Mist Moon was full, with snow on the ground. The portal led to the Koskun Mountains on the plane of Ulgrotha , the home of Eron the Relentless .

On the Plains of Sursi, Serra was attacked by another (disguised) planeswalker , who thought that her wedding ring was some powerful artifact. In her dying moments, she sanctified and revitalized the lands surrounding Sursi. Brother Angus took her body and created the Cathedral of Serra near the Sursi village.
In the Mending Era , Sursi was colonized by Benalia because of its importance to the Church of Serra . The pegasus of the mesa are highly prized by Benalish knights .
